covers: Demo steps 5–7: incompatible purpose from moh to gosi; the RoPA entry also omits its retention period
title: Worker contact details for a health awareness campaign

F-R1.quote: To send insured workers text messages inviting them to the Ministry's national health awareness campaign.

F-R2.quote: PDPL Article 15(3): disclosure requested by a public entity to implement another law, namely the Health Law.

F-R3.quote: Promoting public health awareness, a function given to the Ministry by the Health Law.

F-R4.quote: Employee name, mobile number, employer establishment number.

F-R5.quote: Kept until the awareness campaign ends, then destroyed.

F-R6.quote: Requested by the Ministry of Health from the General Organization for Social Insurance.

F-P1.quote: General Organization for Social Insurance, Data Management Office, privacy@gosi.example

F-P2.quote: Registering private-sector employees and their wages to calculate and collect social insurance contributions and pay benefits.

F-P3.quote: Processing required to implement the Social Insurance Law.

F-P4.quote: Employee name, national ID number, mobile number, employer establishment number, registered monthly wage, contribution history.

F-P5.quote: Private-sector employees registered for social insurance.

F-P6.quote: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development, for labour law enforcement; the Ministry of Health, to confirm workers' insurance status for the treatment of occupational injuries; other government entities where a law requires disclosure.

F-P7.quote: No transfer or disclosure outside the Kingdom.
